description: Built with Team Coding Commanders: an app that tracks household water consumption and rewards saving through challenges and insights — first place at SoliHackathon, May 2024.
Live product giving emergency responders instant access to critical building information via QR codes. Node.js and Prisma backend, React frontend, Stripe subscriptions with webhooks.
Full-stack CRUD application with a Spring Boot API and a React frontend, containerised with Docker — deliberate breadth beyond my main .NET stack.
A small interactive viewer for an office table in React Three Fiber — the bridge between my first 3D experiments and the full configurators above.
